title: Archery
html:
Archery is a Fighting Style passive feature.

Description

You gain a +2 bonus to  Attack Rolls you make with ranged Weapons.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 1: Fighter
  • Class level 2: Ranger

Used by creatures:

  • Add'ath, Aggralix, Agile Guardian, Ahu'u'rag, Antinnia, Arrinye, Bella (Wyrm's Rock Fortress), Chost, Chy'raagh, Clover, Debin, Equidna, G'r'ath, Gai, Glenvora, Gneiss, Gonfalon, Griff, Gummidge, Hagedorrn, Harper Archer, Havard, Helag, Jy'ir, Kethk, Kharyk, Kyberos, Kyrr'a'ath, Lady Croup, Larche, Lionel (Rivington), Loudstone, Madigan, Magnolia, Mibbs, Mîran, Nimba'as, Olloa, Pard, Pol, Ra'gur, Rockbothem, Seyama, The Warden, Un'n, Voss' Raider, Wearne, Zar'an, Zastri, Zeddi'in, Zerentha, Zunii
